2609.21362.title: Beyond Atomic Tokens: Factorizing Syllables for Language Model Pretraining
2609.21362.paper_summary: Conventional tokenizers represent text as characters or statistically derived subwords, overlooking the internal phonological structure of syllables and often requiring large vocabularies. We introduce \textbf{Phonemic Tokenizer}, a linguistically motivated tokenizer for Vietnamese and Chinese that converts each syllable into IPA and factorizes it into three phonological components: onset, rime, and tone. The three components jointly occupy one contextual position, preserving syllable-level sequence length while enabling representation sharing across phonologically related syllables. Non-phonological and unsupported units are handled through character-level fallback. This deterministic design requires no corpus-dependent vocabulary learning and yields vocabularies of only 112 entries for Chinese and 256 for Vietnamese. Intrinsic evaluation shows that the tokenizer achieves substantially higher Rényi efficiency in both languages, represents every entry in a standard Vietnamese syllable dictionary with a Fertility of exactly one, and generally produces shorter Vietnamese sequences than existing pretrained tokenizers. We further instantiate the tokenizer in \textbf{PhonemicBERT}, which combines factorized component embeddings and reconstructs complete masked syllables using three prediction heads. Under a controlled Chinese pretraining setup, PhonemicBERT-Zh is competitive with or outperforms character, subword, and SubChar alternatives across diverse language-understanding tasks. PhonemicBERT-Vi also achieves competitive or superior results to established Vietnamese and multilingual pretrained models. These results establish phonemic factorization as a compact, efficient, and interpretable alternative to atomic and statistically segmented text representations.
2609.21362.paper_summary_zh: 傳統的標記器將文本表示為字符或統計衍生的子詞，忽略了音節的內部音韻結構，並且通常需要大型詞彙庫。 我們介紹了\textbf{音位標記器}，這是一種針對越南語和中文的語言學驅動標記器，將每個音節轉換為國際音標（IPA），並將其分解為三個音韻成分：起始音、韻母和聲調。 這三個成分共同佔據一個上下文位置，保持音節級別的序列長度，同時使音韻相關的音節之間能夠共享表示。 非音韻和不支持的單位通過字符級別的回退來處理。 這種確定性設計不需要依賴語料庫的詞彙學習，並且對於中文僅產生112個條目的詞彙，對於越南語則產生256個條目。 內部評估顯示，該標記器在兩種語言中實現了顯著更高的Rényi效率，並以精確一的繁殖率表示標準越南語音節詞典中的每個條目，通常生成的越南語序列比現有的預訓練標記器更短。 我們進一步在\textbf{音位BERT}中實現了該標記器，該模型結合了分解的成分嵌入，並使用三個預測頭重建完整的遮蔽音節。 在受控的中文預訓練設置下，PhonemicBERT-Zh在各種語言理解任務中與字符、子詞和SubChar替代品具有競爭力或表現更佳。 PhonemicBERT-Vi在已建立的越南語和多語言預訓練模型中也取得了競爭或優越的結果。 這些結果確立了音位分解作為一種緊湊、高效且可解釋的替代方案，取代了原子和統計分段的文本表示。
